label: Bible Study
prompt: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be _____ again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verse: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
note: Said to Nicodemus, who came by night — and promptly asked how a grown man manages it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath _____ a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verse: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
note: What God starts, He finishes — Paul writes this confidence in chains.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a _____, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verse: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
note: A bushel was a grain-measuring basket — the one place you definitely shouldn't hide a lit candle.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a _____ of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verse: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
note: The charter of Christian apologetics — the Greek for 'answer' is apologia, a reasoned defense, offered with meekness.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For I _____ that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verse: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
note: Paul runs the numbers — 'I reckon' — and present sufferings don't even compare to the glory ahead.
